functional_definition.statement: Showing the person who is speaking that one is following them and that they can go on -- keeping the channel open with a short listener signal instead of taking the turn.
counts_as_realization: the resource's taught production is a listener signal: a short unit the hearer produces while the other person holds the turn (the capability's own face in this repository is "Right, I see.", tests/phase3/target_fixtures.py);
saying it claims neither content nor the turn: it acknowledges what the other person said (receipt) and/or invites them to continue;
the signal's own taught function is that receipt/attention -- the ladder teaches it as what to say to show you are listening, not as a request, a report or an evaluation.
does_not_count: speaker moves that bid for the floor or ask something of the hearer ("Sorry to interrupt" is a floor bid, "take a look" / "would you mind" are requests, "I'd like to" frames a request) -- a backchannel is the listener's move;
content vocabulary and idioms whose taught production is a proposition ("take part in", "look forward to", "on the same page", "raise awareness", "draw attention to");
expressions that hand the turn or the decision to the other side as a content claim ("the ball is in your court") rather than as a receipt signal;
acknowledgements the speaker makes of their own point ("what I'm saying is") or corrections of it ("I mean").
boundary_cases: "Sorry to interrupt, but I have a quick question." apologises and then takes the floor: it is a speaker's bid, and a backchannel is a listener's move, so it does not count.
"I'd like to join the group." is a request frame: the taught production has the speaker asking for something rather than showing receipt, so it does not count.

"Right, I see." (the capability's own face in this repository) is a receipt signal produced while the other person is speaking, so it counts -- no resource of the current corpus is of this shape, which is why this node's links are placements at C3-R1.
"I see." said after the other person has finished still answers their talk rather than adding to it: the receipt is what makes it a backchannel, not the overlap.
functional_definition.basis: Authoring judgement made in this repository (C3-R1), read against the canonical vocabulary that actually exists: docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md §7's INTERACT family name and §8's expression subtypes, plus this capability's own taught face -- the fixture reveal "Right, I see." whose hint is "Show you are listening without taking the turn" (tests/phase3/target_fixtures.py). No external psychometric or corpus source is claimed. This definition is the standard the §24.7 links into this node were re-reviewed against (curriculum/README.md, C3-R1); it is a declared reading whose Revisit is registered (a canonical definition would supersede it).
